$comment: The stick is symmetric about the origin (-1.509..1.509 in Z) so its own bounds say nothing about which end is held. What settles it is the knot: it sits at z 0.680..0.842, which is where the sword's guard sits at 0.695..0.815. The two meshes were authored to one convention, so the grip is the same point -- recorded here per file rather than promoted to a project rule, because the third weapon will come from somewhere else. `flat` is arbitrary on a round stick and is +Y to match the sword, so a weapon switch does not roll the wrist.
name: Knotted Stick

provenance.note: 256 triangles, two materials, bent along its length -- which is why `measuredLength` reads the point axis rather than the longest bounding-box side.
